post.description:
Email a sign-in link. Same answer whether or not an account exists.

Rate-limited per address (RATE_LIMIT_MAGIC_LINK_PER_EMAIL, counted whether or not an
account exists, so hitting it reveals nothing) and per client address
(RATE_LIMIT_MAGIC_LINK_PER_IP).

Exchange a magic-link token for tokens. Each link works once, within its TTL.

This is a POST the app makes after opening the link, never a GET on the link itself:
mail scanners prefetch links and would otherwise burn single-use tokens.
Rotate: the presented refresh token is spent and a new pair is returned.

Revoke this device's refresh token (and its rotations). Access tokens expire on
their own within ACCESS_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS.
Revoke every refresh token the user holds (all devices).

Rate-limited per user (RATE_LIMIT_INVITE_JOIN_PER_USER) and per client address

post.description:
Apply a batch of client changes in one transaction (all or nothing).

Every row must belong to one of the user's households, only registered tables and
columns are accepted, and foreign keys must stay inside the household. On a 4xx the
detail says which entry failed; nothing from the batch was written.

notes (an entry must keep a recipe or free text).

list when sent (send ids back to keep existing lines and steps).

sections by `field`. Edits carry `ingredient`, `text` (step) or `value` (section).
